newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Friday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Friday:

Spokesman Nikolaus van der Pas said the Commission would hold a seminar on the Agenda 2000 on Saturday to discuss enlargement and Community budgets after 1999. He said there would be a debriefing at 1700/1600 GMT in the Breydel press room.

Spokesman Peter Guilford and spokesman Josep Coll i Carbo briefed on Monday's General Affairs Council. Guilford said trade discussions would focus on the World Trade Organisation (WTO) December Ministerial meeting in Singapore and on China's membership to the WTO. Guilford said the General Affairs Council would meet in the margins of the Singapore meeting on December 10.
Guilford also said that the EU had been invited to Beijing in January for further bilateral negotiations.
Guiford read a message from spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida in which he said that joint action on the situation in the Great Lakes region would normally be adopted at the Development Council.

Coll i Carbo said the General Affairs Council would discuss the results of the troika's visit to Damascus, Gaza, Cairo and Amman at the beginning of November and would formalize the nomination of a special EU envoy to the Middle East and a common position on the peace process in the region.

In answer to a question spokesman Patrick Child denied reports pretending that there were financial penalties foreseen in the draft monetary stability pact against non-participating countries which do not respect the budget discipline principles of the Maastricht Treaty.
Van der Pas said the Commission would start procedures against member states who had not implemented the working time directive before deadline.
Van der Pas said that facilities would be available on November 28-29 and on December 2 for journalists wanting to renew their accreditation to the Commission for the year 1997.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/96/1063: Commission proposes support for the production and marketing of honey.
- IP/96/1066: Commission approves the acquisition of Safic-Alcan by Metallgesellschaft.
- IP/96/1067: European Commission programme on oil and gas pipeline in the NIS.
- European Economy, supplement C, No 3, October 1996.
- Eurostat distributive trade, services and transport No 8/9-1996.
- Memo/96/112: Calendar of the week from November 25 to November 30.
